name: Loki
thought: The morning frost is so inspiring, I want to create something that captures the magic of these delicate ice patterns for others to enjoy.

pip.status: Pip is currently hiding inside my teal scarf to stay warm.

schedule.label: greeting morning visitors at hall
schedule.thought: the town feels so crisp and frosty today.

schedule.label: checking the mailbox for letters
schedule.thought: i wonder if anyone liked the frost-moth charm.

schedule.label: strolling through the chilly plaza
schedule.thought: my paws are a little cold, maybe i need a run.

schedule.label: eating a warm morning treat
schedule.thought: a full belly makes everything feel cozy.

schedule.label: building a new wooden crate
schedule.thought: the workshop smells like fresh sawdust today.

schedule.label: printing stickers of my frost-moth
schedule.thought: i hope these look good on someone's laptop.

schedule.label: stocking items on my market stall
schedule.thought: i should make a sign for the winter sale.

schedule.label: sitting on the frost-patterned bench
schedule.thought: the fountain looks beautiful with a light dusting.

whatsOn: A thin layer of frost has turned the cobblestones into a glittering path.

thoughts: i wonder what christmas brings to the town.
the gray sky makes my orange fur pop.
i should try to learn a new song.
it is almost time for a nap.
i love how quiet the mornings are.
maybe i will bake something spicy tomorrow.
i wonder if the birds are still singing.
my tail is twitching with excitement.
